{{Quote|My rival Takara has stolen a valuable piece of surveillance equipment, which he uses to listen in on my operations.|translated=1|Ka'Pa, to Mara Jade in Huttese|<ref name="mots" />}}
'''Takara''' was a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and rival of [[Ka'Pa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. He operated his [[Takara's organization|criminal empire]] from a [[Takara's stronghold|stronghold]] protected by [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] and other armed personnel. In his base's dungeon, Takara kept a [[Takara's rancor|rancor]] near his prison. His organization held influence over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katraasii]], so his [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] walked freely among [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. To monitor [[Katraasii Spaceport|spaceport]] activity, Takara deployed [[Abron Mar]],<ref name="mots" /> his right-hand man,<ref name="Feat">{{LucasArts|url=products/sith/sith_features.htm|text=Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith - Features}}</ref> where his top [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] led his forces while frequenting local [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]].<ref name="mots" />

[[File:Takarasfort.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Takara's cliffside headquarters]]
During [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> Takara stole [[Global Communications Transponder|surveillance equipment]] from Ka'Pa to spy on his [[Ka'Pa's criminal empire|operations]].  [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-[[Reciprocal apprenticeship|in-training]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] agreed to [[Mission to negotiate supplies from Ka'Pa the Hutt|retrieve]] it for Ka'Pa if he opened a supply line to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. After chasing Mar from a cantina across the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], Jade cornered the gangster&mdash;or so she thought. His crew surrounded and [[Stun blaster/Legends|stunned]] her. Mar delivered Jade to his boss for Takara to interrogate when she awoke. However, Jade escaped her cell, fought through Takara's guards and rancor, grabbed the device, and fled his stronghold with Ka'Pa's agents.<ref name="mots" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Mara eventually gets ambushed by a crime boss named "Takara" (and yes he's named after a particular brand of sake) and hauled off to his dungeon.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
Takara was first mentioned in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. The character never appears onscreen and is mentioned only by other characters and on a level load screen.<ref name="mots" /> [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] developed the Katraasii-based levels that established Takara's influence and named him after a popular sake, a Japanese alcoholic beverage. Level designer [[Donald Sielke]] created the character's headquarters and Jade's confrontation with his rancor.<ref name="Blog" />
